prova:
exact ⟨{n : ℕ | 2 ≤ n},
    ⟨by
      apply Set.infinite_of_forall_exists_gt
      intro a
      use a + 1
      omega,
    by
      intro a ha
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at ha
      exact ⟨by omega, fun h ↦ by
        rcases h with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        omega⟩,
    by
      -- limit
      simp⟩⟩
